EMS-CTRL-012.policy_decision: Signed commits are recommended for normal development and required only for designated high-assurance or release-signing workflows.
EMS-CTRL-012.policy_notes: Normal development repositories are not required to enforce universal signed commits.

EMS-CTRL-014.policy_decision: Production changes must be traceable to an approved work item through pull request, commit, or automated linkage. GitHub Issues are not specifically required.
EMS-CTRL-014.policy_notes: The control measures change traceability rather than requiring a specific issue-tracking product.

EMS-CTRL-020.policy_decision: Dependency licenses must be evaluated against an approved EMS dependency-license policy using automated scan evidence. Repository LICENSE-file presence alone is insufficient.
EMS-CTRL-020.policy_notes: Remain POLICY_PENDING until the approved dependency-license allow/deny/review policy and authoritative collector are complete.

EMS-CTRL-034.policy_decision: Formal releases must generate an EMS-approved release manifest.
EMS-CTRL-034.policy_notes: Applicability is determined per repository by the Policy Applicability engine. Non-releasing repositories remain NOT_APPLICABLE.

EMS-CTRL-036.policy_decision: Distributable production release artifacts must use approved signing or attestation.
EMS-CTRL-036.policy_notes: Applicability is determined per repository. Repositories without distributable release artifacts remain NOT_APPLICABLE.

EMS-CTRL-038.policy_decision: Repositories using release or version tags must follow the EMS-approved versioning convention.
EMS-CTRL-038.policy_notes: Applicability is determined per repository. Existing inconsistent release tags remain WARNING until normalized.

EMS-CTRL-039.policy_decision: Controlled production releases or deployments must use an approved release or deployment approval workflow.
EMS-CTRL-039.policy_notes: Applicability is determined per repository. Non-releasing and non-deploying repositories remain NOT_APPLICABLE.
